courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Beginning Latin
courses.description: Fundamentals of grammar and reading. Six lecture hours a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Latin 601C; 506 and 507

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: First-Year Latin I
courses.description: Fundamentals of grammar and reading. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Latin 601C; or 506 and 507.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: First-Year Latin II
courses.description: Continuation of Latin 506. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Latin 601C; or 506 and 507 Prerequisite: Latin 506 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Latin 506 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Reading Beginning Latin
courses.description: Restricted to students outside the Department of Classics. Continue exploring beginning-level Latin reading. Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Latin 507 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Latin 507 with a grade of at least C.
courses.restricted: Restricted to students outside the Department of Classics.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Intermediate Latin I
courses.description: Continuation of Latin 601C and 507. Introduction to reading classical authors in their cultural context. Includes grammar review. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Latin 311 and 511K may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Latin 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Latin 601C or 507 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Accelerated Intermediate Latin
courses.description: Five lecture hours a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Latin 511K, 312K, 316. Latin 311 and 511K may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Latin 507 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Latin 507 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Intermediate Latin II
courses.description: Continuation of Latin 311. Selected readings from classical authors. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Latin 511K, 312K, 316. Prerequisite: Latin 311 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Latin 311 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Intermediate Latin II: Poetry
courses.description: Continuation of Latin 311. Selected readings from classical and medieval poets. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Only one of the following may be counted: Latin 511K, 312K, 316. Prerequisite: Latin 311 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Latin 311 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Topics in Seminar in Latin
courses.description: Critical study of authors such as Horace, Livy, Lucretius, and Tacitus. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Latin 323 and 324 with a grade of at least C in each.
courses.prereqText: Latin 323 and 324 with a grade of at least C in each.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Advanced Conference Course
courses.description: Supervised reading. Conference course. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Consent of instructor.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Honors Tutorial Course
courses.description: Supervised conference course for honors candidates in Latin. Three conference hours a week for two semesters. Prerequisite: For 679HA, upper-division standing and admission to the Latin Honors Program; for 679HB, Latin 679HA.
courses.prereqText: For 679HA, upper-division standing and admission to the Latin Honors Program; for 679HB, Latin 679HA.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Proseminar in Classical Literature
courses.description: Brief survey of the history of classical literature; orientation to the major periods and genres. Three hours a week for one semester. Designed for first-year graduate students. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Topics in Proseminar
courses.description: An introduction to the research methodology and the ancillary disciplines used in current classical studies, or to certain disciplines such as meter, textual criticism. One hour a week for one semester. Topics other than those listed below may also be taught. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Offered on the credit/no credit basis only. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.
courses.offering: Offered on the credit/no credit basis only.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Topics in Graduate Reading
courses.description: Topics given in recent years include Latin literature survey, Latin prose, Seneca, and Augustine's Confessions. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Current Concepts and Research in Latin
courses.description: An overview of important theories, issues, and research in classics. Three hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.

courses.title: Topics in Classical Latin Literature
courses.description: Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.

courses.title: Conference Course in Latin Literature

courses.subject: LAT
courses.title: Topics in Seminar in Classical Studies
courses.description: Selected topics in Roman studies. Topics given in recent years include Roman comedy, Pliny, and Roman fragmentary historians. The equivalent of three lecture hours a week for one semester. Topics other than those listed below may also be taught. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
